::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 24th [1888]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge IV 9
:::

Dear [Mr Innes](people/person_744.qmd)

Miss Robertson’s two papers Home Daughters and Power are quite safe, only there has not been room for them yet.[^1] Does she want them back?

I find I cannot get Plataea into the Christmas number, it must come in a regular one. I sent off the bill of fare for the Xmas no yesterday. The first story is [Friday’s Child](other_books/otherbook_1068.qmd), which I think would afford the best illustration. The little boy listening to the old sailor-gardener’s stories would I think be best - To have him sitting in the wood with the dead dog would be too sad, or too like last year’s picture

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Neither of Miss Robertson's articles, nor 'Plataea' seem to have been published in *MP*.
